notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!

Another patch was just added to the game, including some optimizations, quality of life changes and bug fixes. Here are the listed changes:

[list]
[*]Added visual feedback for the dodge’s cooldown duration
[*]Added a tutorial section about dodging
[*]Added an option to skip the tutorial
[*]Added sound effects for when afflictions are triggered
[*]Added sound effects for particles
[*]Added sound effects for when expectation challenges end
[*]Added the credits menu to the the title screen

[*]Updated the splash screen
[*]Updated the focus selection menu and other focus-related UI elements
[*]Updated the game over menu’s buttons to match the diary’s layout
[*]Updated the rocks' collision

[*]Fixed the background disappearing for a short time if Sophie’s Burden was too high
[*]Fixed a bug with Sophie’s attack animation
[*]Fixed a bug that locked Sophie’s movement if she was hit by a flying enemy while being held by a hand
[*]Fixed the Warden walking even after the run was lost
[/list]

Good luck with the struggle!
~Somnitum

notes.title: Inner Struggle 1.1 is now available!
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!
The moment has finally arrived: Inner Struggle's first major content update is officially LIVE!

This update brings a wave of new gameplay systems, unlockables, challenges, and even a brand-new enemy! Here's the full breakdown of what’s changed:

[b]Main Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Focus Paths:[/b] Each Focus Path introduces a unique core mechanic that changes how Sophie survives, including a distinct pool of upgrades exclusive to each path.
[*] [b]Reactions:[/b] Special bonuses that occasionally appear mid-run. They can boost Sophie’s stats and unlock abilities that can turn the tide.
[*] [b]Afflictions:[/b] The heavier the Burden, the harder it gets! New effects will make things tougher as run continues.
[*] [b]Dodging:[/b] Press Shift to dodge through enemies and obstacles (maybe not on the Spider, though!)
[*] [b]New enemy:[/b] the Warden
[*] Added an invulnerability window after taking damage
[*] Added new unlocks and achievements.
[*] The [b]Struggle[/b] stat has been replaced with [b]Burden[/b], a more meaningful measure of Sophie’s fight.
[*] Likewise, Highest [b]Struggle[/b] is now Highest [b]Burden[/b].
[/list]
[b]Minor Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Default key for Dashing changed from Shift to [b]Q[/b] (Shift now triggers Dodge).
[*] Updated various UI elements and in-game sprites.
[*] Slightly increased the camera zoom-out to improve visibility.
[*] Refined several of Sophie’s animation frames.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where menu buttons became unresponsive when pausing during screen transitions.
[*] Fixed fade transitions freezing if the pause menu was opened.
[*] Fixed certain audio volume settings not applying correctly.
[/list]

I hope these additions and changes will improve the overall gameplay experience with Inner Struggle. Sophie's battle grows deeper with each new attempt, and as she tries new ways of breaking free, the environment also finds new ways of ruining her efforts... Will it ever be enough?

Well, that’s all for now. This is truly the best time to dive in. And over the coming days, I’ll be actively monitoring for bugs, feedback, and opportunities to implement more quality-of-life improvements.

Thank you so much for everything! And now more than ever:
Good luck with the struggle.
~Somnitum

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!

Another patch was just added to the game (this one is the biggest so far!) including some quality of life improvements, updated visuals and bug fixes. Here are the listed changes:

[list]
[*]Added 2 new stats in the Stats Menu
[*]Added animations for the dialogue boxes
[*]Added a custom cursor visual
[*]Added a feedback effect whenever the player selects a choice that fails to motivate Sophie
[*]Added a sound effect that plays whenever a new tutorial text box is displayed
[*]Added a text indicating what key to press in order to make Sophie ponder

[*]Updated the Input System to support Arrow Keys and Gamepad playstyles
[*]Updated the spider's idle animation
[*]Updated the menu's navigation to make it smoother
[*]Updated the tutorial text boxes' visuals
[*]Updated the dialogue cursor's visual
[*]Updated the camera transitions to make them smoother

[*]Fixed the audio volume settings not being saved
[*]Fixed the tutorial sometimes not restarting if the player got caught near the end
[*]Fixed the background sometimes not filling the entire screen
[*]Fixed not being able to climb ledges by pressing the up arrow key
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed the player to continue charging the sprint after losing a run and opening the diary
[/list]

If you happen to come across any other bugs, please do not hesitate to let me know in the comments so I can fix them as soon as possible.

Good luck in the struggle!
~Somnitum

[*]Fixed the resolution settings menu not working properly
[*]Fixed the video settings not being saved even after being selected
[*]Fixed the back button not working when clicked on the main menu

[/list]

If you happen to come across any other bugs, please do not hesitate to let me know in the comments so I can fix them as soon as possible.

Good luck with the struggle!
~Somnitum

If you happen to come across any other bugs, please don't hesitate to let me know in the comments so I can be aware of them and provide additional fixes as soon as possible.

Good luck with the struggle!
